The finding that changed code justification: P4. `required` in
lexicons/fyi.forage.tagsub.json binds Forage and nobody else. Anything may put a
malformed record in a repo we then read, which makes wellFormed() in
js/tagsubs-pds.js load-bearing rather than defensive. W17 asserts P4 still holds,
so the day a PDS starts validating is a day we are told.
